title: My Friends and Family
text:
My friend Ali is very kind. He helps me with my homework. He is also funny. He always makes me laugh.

My sister Ayşe is shy. She does not talk a lot in class. But she is very smart. She reads many books.

options: She does not talk a lot

questions.text: What kind of person is Ali?
Why is Ayşe probably good at school?

vocabulary.definition: caring about other people and wanting to help them
feeling nervous when you meet or talk to other people
able to learn and understand things quickly

paragraph_translations: Arkadaşım Ali çok iyi kalpli. Bana ödevlerimde yardım eder. Ayrıca komik. Beni her zaman güldürür.
Kız kardeşim Ayşe utangaçtır. Sınıfta çok konuşmaz. Ama çok zekidir. Birçok kitap okur.
